messages:
anya: Power went out so i'm on the porch with a battery pack and a camping lantern. makeshift office vibes. photo incoming.
cole: Porch office = cottagecore engineering, love it. :herb: pics pls
anya: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F55555/porch-setup.jpg (yes that's a folding table and a dog bed)
cole: how's the hotspot? usable?
anya: 7 Mbps down, 1.5 up, ~140ms. fine for audio and quick deploy checks. pro tip: turn off video, lower resolution.
infra-bot: Reminder: do not bridge personal routers to corporate VLANs. For critical work on personal hotspots, request an approved temporary VPN from infra.
cole: we should compile a tiny "WFH emergency kit" doc: battery, ethernet cable, lantern, zip ties, snacks. thumbs?
anya: thumbs up. i'll add the porch photo and a one-liner list.
cole: also add "pet management" item. dog nearly rebooted my laptop by sitting on it. :dog:
